recommendations: Separate the whole population from the electorate qualified for the date and institution.
Use stable legal/administrative identities with dated names; do not merge same-named corporations without a continuation instrument.
Use separate political responsibility, statutory administration, ownership, appointment, funding, audit, complaint, service, membership and asset-transfer edges.
Only source-supported political, legislative and reporting relationships form accountability routes; ownership/funding/appointment alone are insufficient.
Keep First Nations governments as governments with treaty and membership relations.
Keep made, effective, observed, deadline and executed dates separate; preserve year, season, period and null precision.
Treat a legal entity, operating service, public program, special account, web resource and brand as different entity types.
Implement minister-office nodes and officeholder intervals when source-backed; do not infer universal direct ministerial control.
